contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [CAESAR AVG F DOMITIANVS] ; R/ [CO]S IIII

An incomplete silver Roman plated denarius of Domitian as Caesar under Vespasian (AD 69-71), dating to AD 76-77 (Reece Period 4). COS IIII, Pegasus walking right reverse. Mint of Rome. RIC II (2nd ed), p. 125, no. 921. Cf. BMC no. 193; (Old edition RIC II no. 238). Obverse description: Laureate head right. Obverse inscription: [CAESAR AVG F DOMITIANVS]. Reverse description: Pegasus advancing…
